mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 30 days signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST have declined for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate signals the Federal Reserve's aggressive inflation control, which initially causes volatility but ultimately leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic stability returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS has increased by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 30 days indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased by at least 100,000 jobs over 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,000,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where HOUST has been below 1000.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown in manufacturing and overall output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both INDPRO and GDPC1 have declined for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a sudden drop in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where RSAFS has declined from a level above 500,000 million dollars.
